growth.note: The bound applies to every fixture measured at more than one size, and it is 1.25 because the cost per plan entry has to stay flat as the fleet grows: `fleet` grows the number of entries and keeps each entry's own work constant, `mesh` grows one entry's work with the fleet and keeps the plan linear in it, and a quarter of slack absorbs constant-factor noise without admitting any super-linear term.

worked.note: Moved by generate-values-with-nixos-secrets: a generated value's entry gained the program its generator declares, every file record in the plan gained `deploy`, and a declared program enters the value's key. Two more fields per value entry and one per file, so per-entry cost rose by a fraction of a percent at every fixture and every size. The figures are re-recorded rather than the margin widened, so the next change is gated against these.
